one_line: An expert's own book announced in four text cards, the benefit shown in play, one comment word to get it.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 handheld extreme close-up of a toddler's face, a woman behind him; he raises a finger. Text cards "פססס" (0:00), "חברים" (0:01), "כתבה" (0:02), "ספר" (0:03). Transcript: "חברים, מסליק את הספר!" (garbled).
q1_hook.why: A toddler's face at the lens and a shushing card are a pattern break (H1, K8), and four short cards, "friends", "wrote", "book", pose a gap answered by the cover at 0:04 (H5). But the first frame is too close and blurred to work as a cover (H7), and who speaks is unclear (H4, H6).

beats.what: Extreme close-up of a toddler, a woman behind; cards "פססס", "חברים", "כתבה", "ספר"
beats.why: Personal news in four words, with faces

beats.what: The toddler holds up a hardcover book; its cover top-down on a wood floor
beats.why: The book appears at 0:04 and is held still

beats.what: The toddler walks to the woman on the sofa; "אבל אצלכם- הילד שלכם הוא הגיבור"
beats.why: States the promise to the viewer

beats.what: A MeBook.ai logo box over a page; she reads with the toddler; "פנו אליי לכתוב ספר מיועד לילדים"
beats.why: Names the brand and the author angle

beats.what: The toddler dances; "אז כתבתי ספר שיעודד פעילות מוטורית", "עם טיפים"
beats.why: Says what the book is for

beats.what: She raises a ball, the toddler jumps; "המטרה היא לעודד פעילות גופנית בכיף!"
beats.why: The movement idea shown, not only said

beats.what: She and the toddler sit cross-legged, calm; "תזכו בזמן איכות מלא תנועה וכיף"
beats.why: A quiet beat with the parent's benefit

beats.what: A hug on the sofa; "איך משיגים אותו? קראו בתיאור"
beats.why: The ask comes after the warm moment

beats.what: White logo card "YUVAL ASAEL" with black bars above and below
beats.why: A brand card after the ask, no new information

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption: comment the word "ספר" to get a link by message ("תגיבו את המילה ״ספר״ ולינק ישלח אליכם"); a coupon code in her story for followers. The video itself says only "קראו בתיאור".
q2_flow.why: The opener, "I wrote a book", is answered by the cover at 0:05 (H5), and the physio angle, movement tips, is clear by 0:17 (K4). The 0:18 to 0:28 stretch is one play scene with new text every 3 s (R3). A 3 s logo card after the ask is a tail (R1, E8).

q3_cta.what: On screen 0:28 to 0:31: "איך משיגים אותו? קראו בתיאור". Caption: "תגיבו את המילה ״ספר״ ולינק ישלח אליכם" and a coupon code in her story for followers. A logo card ends the video.
q3_cta.why: The video only says to read the description; the actual ask, comment the word for a link, sits at the end of a very long caption (C6). The word delivers something concrete (C3, R6), but a coupon in her story adds a second action (C1).

q4_shown.what: The hardcover book held up by a toddler (0:04) and top-down (0:06); illustrated pages (0:10, 0:13); the MeBook.ai logo over a page (0:10 to 0:12); a ball-and-movement game (0:18 to 0:24); a hug (0:28). No price or ordering step.
q4_shown.why: A professional's own book is a credible angle, and the movement game shows what it is for (S6, K4). The cover with the child's name and a hero is held still about 2 s (S2 partly). The book is on screen about a third of the time (K5); a child's face and name show (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 10 shots in 35 s: quick cuts for 15 s, then one scene of play in about 3 takes. Text cards with emojis change every 1 to 3 s. Ends on a white logo card with black bars (0:32 to 0:35).
q5_edit.why: Fast cuts and big text open with energy (E1), and the play scene lets the child's movement carry the middle (R3). Cards every 1 to 3 s are enough to follow (E4, T2). The white card with black bars is a bordered, non-native ending (F1, F3, E8).

q6_topic.what: A developmental physiotherapist announces a personalised book she wrote with movement tips, shown with a toddler's play. Serves parents who want movement play.
q6_topic.why: An expert's own project gives a personalised book a developmental angle wrapped in play (K4), and the announcement tone is personal and excited (K1, S6). The claims are modest, but no age or occasion is named on screen (K7 not met).

q7_filmed.what: A handheld, too-close selfie for the hook; top-down shots of the book on a wood floor; static eye-level wide shots in a daylit living room. A woman and a toddler. The end card is a white square on a black frame.
q7_filmed.why: A home, daylight and a real woman and child give a native look (H8, F7). The first frame is too close and blurred to read as a cover (H7). Wide shots make the book small (F4). The end card breaks full-screen vertical with black bars (F1, F3).

q8_text.on_screen: Thin white sans text with emojis, 1 to 3 lines, mid to lower frame: "פססס" (0:00), "חברים" (0:01), "כתבה" (0:02), "ספר" (0:03), "אבל אצלכם- הילד שלכם הוא הגיבור" (0:08), "פנו אליי לכתוב ספר מיועד לילדים" (0:11), "המטרה היא לעודד פעילות גופנית בכיף!" (0:18), "קראו בתיאור" (0:28). The MeBook.ai logo box covers the frame at 0:10 to 0:12; the child's name is on screen at 0:06.
q8_text.caption: "כתבתי ספר 🤯📖✍️" then "ואני כלכך מתרגשת לשתף אתכם". About 240 words: the collaboration line third, a product paragraph, her role, the book's content and target age, the comment-word ask, then 12 hashtags.
q8_text.why: Text cards with emojis carry the story muted (T1), but the thin small type changes every 1 to 3 s (T5). The caption opens with a clear hook (T7) but is very long, with 12 hashtags against the rule's 5 (T7), and the collaboration words sit in its third paragraph (T8).

weak_points: First frame too close and blurred; a logo box over the picture for about 3 s; ends on a bordered logo card; the real ask sits in a very long caption; 12 hashtags; two asks; the child's name shown.
lumebook_takeaway: Open on a person with one clear line, hold the cover still, show the benefit in action, and put the one comment-word CTA on screen, not only in the caption.
not_verified: Who speaks in the first 3 s (the transcript is garbled); music (cannot hear); the coupon code (in her story, not seen); the exact first card (a shushing emoji and a short word, read as "פססס"). Correction to src/coded: the end card is a white square with black bars above and below, 0:32 to 0:35, and the MeBook.ai logo box covers the picture at 0:10 to 0:12.
